I have the Samsung NX58H5600SS/AA Range. To be clear to all reviewers reading this, I did not buy this igniter because I found out that this Samsung igniter part is identical to the Whirlpool/Maytag part #12400035 but at three times the price! See my attached photos. Basically, Coorstek manufactures this igniter for multiple brands of gas ranges and it turns out the Maytag one has an identical mounting bracket and plug connector that fits a Samsung Range (Just toss the extra parts you don’t need). While Samsung makes a great range, it’s sad that it seems that they want part suppliers to charge a premium for a “genuine” part when it’s really is identical to a competitor’s range. Get the Maytag part and you won’t go wrong!

Ordered Hot Surface Igniter as replacement in in Samsung NX58H5600SS/AA gas range broiler.  Followed fire in broiler area of oven,  Original hot surface igniter glowed but no ignition.  After installing new hot surface igniter discovered no ignition was due to clogged orifice.  After cleaning orifice broiler ignited and workes.  Kept new hot surface igniter installed although original would probably have worked.  New hot surface igniter continues to work well, even through one more fire in broiler area. Will not place any greasy foods inn broiler since so close to broiler flames that easily ignite grease.

Hot surface ignitors seem to be relatively universal.  However, I found the pin connection to be the failure point more often than the actual carbon filament.  Problem is the carbon filament is brittle and cheap even when brand new.  I recommend spending the extra money for genuine OEM and also cutting out the OEM pins if their housings have begun to brown.  Use either porcelain or blavk heat resistant wire nuts or a higher end quality heat shrink insulated sta-con kit.

The oven even lights faster using the OEM two element igniter. Highly recommend!
